Education

Degrees

Honours and awards
-King Willem-Alexander Chair, Guest professor, Liège Université, Belgium (2024-2025).
-Guest professor, Department of History of Science and Ideas, Uppsala University, Sweden (2022-2024).
« Pour une sociologie historique et réflexive de la sociologie. Autour de Johan Heilbron », Special conference around the work of Johan Heilbron, Paris, Institut d’études avancées, le 9 décembre 2021.
-Guest professor in the Sociology of Education, Department of Education & Research unit Sociology of Education and Culture (SEC), Uppsala University, Sweden (2019-2022).
- Member of the Academia Europaea (2019- ), https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Heilbron_Johan
- *Doctor honoris causa* conferred by Uppsala University, 25 January 2018.
-Member of the Institute for Advanced Study (IAS) in Princeton (2017-2018).
-Distinguished Publication Award 2016, American Sociological Association, Section for History of Sociology for *French Sociology* (Cornell University Press, 2015).
-Visiting professor at the International Research Center in the Humanities and the Social Sciences (CIRHUS), New York University (May 2015)
-George Sarton Medal for the History of Science (life time achievement award) of the University of Gent, Belgium (2014).
- Fellow Netherlands Institute for Advanced Study (NIAS), Wassenaar, The Netherlands (2009-2010).
- Guest Professor, Department of sociology, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, USA (February - May 2009).
- Norbert Elias chair in the Sociology of Long-Term Processes, Utrecht University (2000-2004) and Erasmus University Rotterdam (2004-2008), The Netherlands.
- Honorary fellow of the Department of the sciences of art and culture, Erasmus University Rotterdam, The Netherlands (1992 - 1996)
- Fellowship for excellence of the Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences (KNAW)(1992 - 1995), Amsterdam, Netherlands.
- Fellow of the Swedish Collegium for Advanced Study (SCAS), Uppsala, Sweden (1988 - 1989)
- Fellow of the Wissenschaftskolleg zu Berlin – Institute for Advanced Study, Berlin, Germany (1985 - 1986)

Main academic positions (selection)
- Scientific collaborator at the Foundation for Interuniversity Social Scientific research (SISWO), Amsterdam (1981 - 82)
- Research grant, Netherlands Organization for Scientific Research (NWO, 1982)
- Lecturer at the sociology department, University of Amsterdam (various periods during the 1980s and early 1990s)
- Affiliated researcher with the Centre de sociologie européenne, École des Hautes Études en Sciences Sociales (EHESS) in Paris (1983 - 1985) (grants from the Fondation Hugot of the Collège de France and the Maison des Sciences de l’Homme)
- Fellow of the Amsterdam School for Social Science Research (ASSR) (1987-1988, 1992-1995)
- Maître de conférences associé at the École des Hautes Etudes en Sciences Sociales (EHESS) (1990)
- Reader at the department for the sciences of art and culture, Erasmus University Rotterdam (1990 - 1992)
- Associated fellow of the Amsterdam School for Social Science Research (ASSR) (1995-2000)
- Junior Researcher, then Director of Research at the Centre National de la recherche scientifique (CNRS) in France, member of the Centre Lillois d’Études et de Recherches Sociologiques et Économiques (CLERSE) (1996 - 2000) and the Centre Européen de Sociologie et de Science Politique (CESSP) (2000-2018)
-Professor of economic sociology (part-time), Erasmus University Rotterdam, Netherlands, founding Director of the Erasmus Center for Economic Sociology (ECES)(2008-2018); since 2018 professor emeritus.
-Director of Research emeritus, Centre National de la recherche scientifique (CNRS), France, member of the Centre Européen de Sociologie et de Science Politique (CESSP) (2018 - )
